Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
After a long discussion with my playgroup I prefer to make this post to clarify anything.

I need to play Freak Drive after a action resolution, but I need to do that after or before the effects of action are concluded?

Exemples:
When a vampire use a Chain of Command, I need to play Freak Drive after or before the effect of CoC (bring vamps and bleed with them)?

When a vampire use Deep Song to enter in combat (and it is not blocked), can I to play Freak Drive/Forced March after or before the effect of Deep Song (combat)?

When a vampire call a political action can I play Freak Drive after or before the referendum (when votes and ballots are cast)?

A acting vampire was blocked and during the combat they is target of a Rotschreck, can I play a superior Freak Drive to unlock?

Name: Freak Drive
[Jyhad:R2, VTES:R, CE:U/PV2, Anarchs:PG, LoB:PA2, Third:U, LotN:PR, KoT:PV3, HttB:PSam2, 25th:3]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Fortitude
Only usable after action resolution.
[for] Only usable if the action was successful. Unlock this vampire.
[FOR] Only usable if the action was blocked. Unlock this vampire.
Artist: Daniel Gelon; Nilson; Ken Meyer, Jr.

[FOR] Only usable if the action was blocked. Unlock this vampire.
Artist: Daniel Gelon; Nilson; Ken Meyer, Jr.

So,
Freak Drive after the end of the action means
- after block resolution - after combat if blocked.
- atfer the referendum if political action
- after puting into play vampires from Chain of Command - New vampires will have to take another action to bleed. Those bleed actions do not belong to Chain of Command resolution.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Sydnelson wrote:
> When a vampire use a Chain of Command, I need to play Freak Drive after or before the effect of CoC (bring vamps and bleed with them)?
>
After bringing the vampires in play, during that action. The fact that the vampires brought in play must do something has nothing to do with the current action, those are mandatory actions for after this action.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> When a vampire use Deep Song to enter in combat (and it is not blocked), can I to play Freak Drive/Forced March after or before the effect of Deep Song (combat)?
>
After resolution, that is after the combat is concluded.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> When a vampire call a political action can I play Freak Drive after or before the referendum (when votes and ballots are cast)?
>
After resolution, that is after the referendum is concluded.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> A acting vampire was blocked and during the combat they is target of a Rotschreck, can I play a superior Freak Drive to unlock?
>
Rötschreck ends combat, but no the action. So you can play Freak Drive after resolution (that is after the combat has ended).

"After resolution" means you after you have resolved all the effects relative to that action.
